selection_rationale: Next most relevant Karachi options for a BS AI/CS student: SZABIST, Bahria Karachi, UoK (UBIT), SSUET, MAJU offer BS AI + BS CS; DUET added as low-cost public BS CS option. Aga Khan University excluded (no computing UG).
